title: Group working around high table in an open lab with exposed ceiling and glass partitions
objects_and_counts: At least seven people are visible: five clustered around the central high table (one wearing a black suit jacket, one in a white jacket, one in a mustard/olive jacket, one in a navy/white jacket leaning over the table, and one in a black puffy coat standing), one person visible sitting or standing at a desk in the far right background, and one person visible in the left background near a bench or work area.
Two laptop computers are visible on the central table: one silver laptop near the center and one laptop or screen near the right side of the same table (partially obscured by a person leaning).
One desktop monitor is visible on the central table (upright, between the laptops and the right-side users).
One ceiling-mounted projector is visible, turned on (bright light visible) and suspended above the central area.
Two large high worktables are visible in the foreground and midground (the central table where people cluster and at least one similar table to the left).
Multiple tall stools are visible around the tables; at least eight distinct stools can be individually counted in the foreground and midground (some stools are partially obscured or cropped).
Glass partition walls and glass doors are visible at the rear of the scene, separating the central working area from adjacent rooms.
Various posters, notices and small wall signs are visible on the glass partition and doors but most are partially obscured or too small to read in full.
spatial_relations: A large high table occupies center foreground with people standing and leaning around all sides; stools are positioned under and around this table.
Another matching high table is visible to the left of the central table, oriented parallel and with stools around it.
A ceiling-mounted projector is positioned above the central table and projects a bright light downwards; hanging cables run from the ceiling near the projector toward the table area.
Glass partition walls and two glass doors form the rear boundary of the visible workspace; posters and notices are affixed to the glass surfaces and doors.
A bench or work area with shelving and equipment is visible behind the left-side table, separated from the central area by a short open corridor.
colours_and_materials: The central and left high tables have light-colored wooden tops and grey metal legs.
Stools have dark brown or black seats and dark metal legs (some appear wooden seats, but material is not certain).
The ceiling shows exposed metal ducting and structural elements in silver/grey; rectangular recessed light panels are white and emit bright light.
Flooring appears to be a smooth light grey material (possibly vinyl or polished concrete).
Walls and glass partitions are primarily white and transparent glass, with small colourful posters affixed.
uncertainties: Exact count of people could be affected by partial occlusion; I counted seven distinct visible people but some individuals are partially obscured and there may be more outside the frame.
Some text on posters, notices and small labels on the glass and walls is too small or blurred to transcribe; only the vertical door label 'PUSH' is clearly legible.
Identification of object types (for example distinguishing a second laptop from a tablet or monitor) is based on visible form and may be ambiguous for partially obscured screens.
Material identifications of stools (wood vs. other dark materials) and floor surface are visual assessments and not confirmed.
There are additional small labels and signs near the glass doors and on nearby equipment that contain text but are unreadable at this resolution.
